description: Source code for launching and managing a web application within the Playwright testing framework, including functions to launch apps, install app icons, and sync local storage with settings.

classes.name: ProgressController
classes.description: Class managing progress during asynchronous operations.

methods.name: launchApp
methods.description: Launches a browser app with specified options, handling platform-specific behavior and app icon installation.

methods.name: installAppIcon
methods.description: Reads and sets the app icon in the browser's dock (macOS).

methods.name: syncLocalStorageWithSettings
methods.description: Synchronizes local storage with a JSON settings file for a given app.
